title: U.S. inflation, corporate earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
content: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 9.

title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer worth 17 times its bitcoin pile
content: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
content: A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
content: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
content: The exchange's once significant mining operation has nearly disappeared from Bitcoin's block-production rankings ahead of its November 10 closure.

title: Binance, Tether and Trump crypto firms face Senate records deadline
content: Sen. Richard Blumenthal asked four crypto firms to start sending records by Nov. 30 and warned of further action if they miss the Jan. 4 deadline.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.3B in biggest weekly outflow since late June
content: Investors pulled a net $1.21 billion from BlackRock’s IBIT last week as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US technology stocks sold off.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
content: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
content: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

title: Nvidia Board Investigates Jensen Huang After Report He Was Target of Chinese Spy Effort
content: Huang told staff he had been "unfaithful" to his wife, as Nvidia shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading on Monday.

title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
content: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

title: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
content: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
content: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.

title: Sony Axing Game Discs Will Have Outsized Impact on Low-Income Gamers, Experts Say
content: Experts say a disc-free PlayStation will price out low-income players, while in much of Africa, digital-only gaming means breaking Sony’s rules.

title: U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows
content: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows FinCEN issued a final order under section 9714(a) that will bar U.S. financial institutions from sending or receiving funds with MEXC Global 30 days after Federal Register publication, citing at least $16 billion in alleged illicit activity. This post U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Magazine Books Opens 333-Copy Genesis Book Collector Edition for 3rd Anniversary
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Magazine Books Opens 333-Copy Genesis Book Collector Edition for 3rd Anniversary Bitcoin Magazine Books opened a third-anniversary campaign for Aaron van Wirdum's The Genesis Book, capping a hand-signed Collectors Edition at 333 numbered copies. This post Bitcoin Magazine Books Opens 333-Copy Genesis Book Collector Edition for 3rd Anniversary first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block
content: Bitcoin Magazine Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget operator BG Limited for unlicensed Thai trading from 2022 to 2025. This post Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations
content: Bitcoin Magazine Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, of Ashburn, Virginia, pleaded guilty Thursday to wire fraud and money laundering after using wallet credentials from 35 FBI investigations to take about $2.47 million in cryptocurrency. This post Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Strive (ASST) Posts $474.8 Million Common Net Income as Bitcoin Yield Hits 63.2%
